title: Frame Sidecar Schema
description: Per-frame sidecar written beside an extracted frame PNG (output of extract_frames_from_videos.py). Carries the frame's detections and its parent-clip link.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID v4) for this frame's sidecar

frame_number.description: Frame index (clip-relative for clip-frame extraction, absolute for source-frame extraction)

detections.description: Detections on this frame (the parent sidecar's frame_data entries)

title.description: Dublin Core title (dct:title); optional, injected by add_fair_metadata when available

creator.description: Dublin Core creator (dct:creator); optional, injected by add_fair_metadata when available

source.description: Upstream attribution (archive.org id/url, license); injected by add_fair_metadata when available

producer.description: Reproducibility: pipeline commit, config hash and model files that produced this sidecar

@context.description: Shared JSON-LD context (Dublin Core Terms + PROV-O); injected by add_fair_metadata
